title: Extension by zero preserves constant-local-model constructibility
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and let $j\colon U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ for $T=U,X$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $j_!\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_U}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ be the extension by zero of module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek].

Let $M$ be a $\Lambda_U$-module that is constructible in the sense of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]: there is a finite stratification $U=\coprod_aU_a$ [def-constructible-stratification] by constructible locally closed subschemes such that each $M|_{U_a}$ has a finite constant local model [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Then $j_!M$ is a constructible $\Lambda_X$-module in the same sense. More precisely, the subschemes $U_a$, viewed in $X$, together with the closed complement $Z=X\setminus U$ with its reduced subscheme structure [def-pc-reduced-scheme], form a finite stratification of $X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes; for every $a$ the restriction $(j_!M)|_{U_a}$ is isomorphic, as a $\Lambda_{U_a}$-module, to $M|_{U_a}$, and $(j_!M)|_Z=0$. The cases $U=\varnothing$ (then $M=0$ and $j_!M=0$) and $U=X$ (then $Z=\varnothing$) are included.

proof.text: The finite-type-over-a-field case in [def-weil-constructible-subset] applies by [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: X is Noetherian, and every locally closed subset is constructible. To view each given stratum as a locally closed subscheme of X, factor its immersion into U as a closed immersion into an open subscheme W of U followed by W→U; W is also open in X, so the same closed immersion into W defines the required immersion into X. The closed subset X\U has the reduced induced closed subscheme Z by [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Its image is closed, hence locally closed and constructible. The strata remain pairwise disjoint and cover U; adding Z gives a finite disjoint cover of X, hence the stratification of [def-constructible-stratification]. Moreover j is quasi-compact: for any affine open V in X, U∩V is quasi-compact, since U is retrocompact in the Noetherian space X by [def-weil-constructible-subset].

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed] with $A=\Lambda_X$ and the complementary pair $(j,i\colon Z\to X)$ of step 1; its hypothesis that $j$ is quasi-compact was checked there. Its functors are sectionwise module functors, which we now identify with the module-object functors. By [sk-def-sfb-ring-object] the sheaf tensor product is the sheafified sectionwise tensor product, so a map from it to a sheaf is a compatible family of sectionwise bilinear maps; hence the ring and module objects of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] are exactly the sheaves of rings and of modules of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with the same morphisms. For $g\in\{j,i\}$ with source $T$, the inverse image $g^{-1}$ of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and the pullback $g^*_{\Ab}$ of [def-sfb-finite-upper-star] are both the sheafification of the colimit of $\mathcal F(V)$ over the same category of pairs $(V,\,T'\to T\times_XV)$, the left Kan extension along the opposite of the base-change functor. The canonical comparison $g^{-1}\cong g^*_{\Ab}$ respects the sectionwise ring and module operations, so it identifies $g^{-1}\Lambda_X$ with the ring object $g^*_{\Ab}\Lambda_X$ and $g^{-1}$ on modules with $\operatorname{mapMod}(g^*_{\Ab})$. The module $j_!$ of the ringed theorem is left adjoint to $j^{-1}$, and $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!$ of [def-sfb-module-linear-open-lower-shriek] is left adjoint to $\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$. These are two left adjoints of one functor $\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}$, so by [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] with $\delta=\mathrm{id}$ they are naturally isomorphic.

proof.text: By [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], $\alpha_j\colon j^*\Lambda_X\to\Lambda_U$ and $\alpha_i\colon i^*\Lambda_X\to\Lambda_Z$ are isomorphisms of ring objects, so clause 5 of [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] gives $\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha}\cong\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha^{-1}}$, a quasi-inverse of $\operatorname{Res}_\alpha$. The module pullback is $g^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_g}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(g^*_{\Ab})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], and $j_!=j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\circ\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. With step 2 and the identities $j^{-1}j_!\cong\mathrm{id}$ and $i^{-1}j_!=0$ of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed], applied to the $j^{-1}\Lambda_X$-module $\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}M$, this gives $j^*j_!M\cong\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_j}\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}M\cong M$ as $\Lambda_U$-modules. It also gives $i^*j_!M\cong\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_i}(0)=0$ as $\Lambda_Z$-modules, since the left adjoint $\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_i}$ is additive and sends zero to zero. For the immersion $h_a\colon U_a\to U$ of a stratum, $j\circ h_a$ is the immersion of step 1, and the composition isomorphism $(j\circ h_a)^*\cong h_a^*j^*$ of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] gives $(j_!M)|_{U_a}\cong h_a^*M=M|_{U_a}$.

proof.text: Write N=j_!M. For each a choose the pro-étale cover {V_ai→U_a}, finitely presented Λ(*)-modules P_ai, and isomorphisms M|_{V_ai}≅Λ_{V_ai}⊗_{Λ(*)}P_ai given by [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Pull back the isomorphism N|_{U_a}≅M|_{U_a} of step 3 to V_ai, then compose with this chosen isomorphism. This explicitly gives N|_{V_ai}≅Λ_{V_ai}⊗_{Λ(*)}P_ai, using precisely the same cover, modules and scalar maps. Restriction means module pullback, and iterated restrictions agree by [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. On Z, step 3 gives N|_Z=0; use the identity cover and P=0, whose finite presentation is Λ(*)^0→Λ(*)^0→0 and whose scalar extension is zero. The stratification in step 1 and these local models give constructibility by [sk-def-sfb-constructible].

source.place: paragraph 'Constructibility': restrictions are locally constant on the same strata and zero on the added closed stratum

proof.text: The construction also handles the empty-open and identity-open cases. If U=∅, every object of its small pro-étale site is empty, and the empty covering forces every abelian sheaf value to be zero; hence M=0. The additive extension by zero of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] sends this to zero, and the rank-zero presentation in step 4 gives a constant local model on X. If U=X, Z=∅ and the original strata and models already suffice. An empty stratum may be retained in the finite-family definition [def-constructible-stratification], or omitted. The same argument also covers X=∅.

lean.statement: theorem constantModelConstructible_openImmersionLowerShriek (ℓ p : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] [Fact p.Prime] (_hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p] (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {U X : Scheme.{u}} [U.Over (Spec (.of k))] [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U)) (S : Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification U) (_hS : ∀ a : Fin S.n, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum a)) (_hM : ∀ a : Fin S.n, HasFiniteConstantLocalModel Λ (S.domain a) ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ (S.immersion a)).obj M)) : IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X ((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).obj M) ∧ (∃ (T : Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X) (e : Fin T.n ≃ Option (Fin S.n)), (∀ b : Fin T.n, Topology.IsConstructible (T.stratum b)) ∧ (∀ b : Fin T.n, match e b with | none => Nonempty (Over.mk (T.immersion b) ≅ Over.mk j.closedComplement) | some a => Nonempty (Over.mk (T.immersion b) ≅ Over.mk (S.immersion a ≫ j)))) ∧ (∀ a : Fin S.n, Nonempty ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ (S.immersion a ≫ j)).obj ((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).obj M) ≅ (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ (S.immersion a)).obj M)) ∧ IsZero ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ j.closedComplement).obj ((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).obj M)) ∧ (IsEmpty U → IsZero M ∧ IsZero ((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).obj M)) ∧ (IsIso j → IsEmpty (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal ⟨(j.opensRange : Set X)ᶜ, j.opensRange.isOpen.isClosed_compl⟩).subscheme)
